newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Merchant Bank up on retail demand.
newsitem.headline: Merchant Bank up on retail demand.

text.p: Shares in Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka Ltd rose by 4.5 pecent, or 75 cents, to 17.50 rupees in early Tuesday trading on limited buying by retail investors, brokers said.
Merchant Bank has a good exposure to plantation shares which have risen recently because of high tea prices, traders said.
Brokers said the rise in Merchant Bank stock prices was on a small volume of 3,500 shares.
"The scrip is an ideal retail share because it is cheap and affordable," said a broker specialising in small investors.
